prediction_task: Pediatric pneumonia classifier (DenseNet-121, Kaggle pneumonia weights)
training_data: Kaggle Chest X-Ray Images (Pneumonia), pediatric patients
published_evaluation: Per-pathology AUCs were published by the torchxrayvision authors (Cohen et al., 'Torchxrayvision: A library of chest X-ray datasets and models', MIDL 2022). Weights are used as released; we did NOT re-validate them on a held-out set in this project and did not fine-tune them.
preprocessing: Input loaded and scaled to roughly [-1024, 1024] gray scale via torchxrayvision.utils.load_image; the model resizes to its trained resolution.
limitations: Trained on frontal chest X-rays; non-CXR images or CT/MRI/ultrasound are invalid inputs.
Probabilities are uncalibrated and prevalence-dependent; not validated for individual risk.
Grad-CAM overlays are activation explanations, not diagnostic evidence.
No local re-validation was performed; metrics quoted are from the original publications.
intended_use: Research and educational demonstration of explainable medical-image analysis.
